stdout.pattern:
usage: git2 init [-q] [--bare] [-b <name>] [--separate-git-dir=<git-dir>]
                  [--template=<template-dir>] [--] [<directory>]

Create a new git repository.

Options:
    -q, --quiet
        quiet mode; don't display informational messages
    --bare
        don't create a working directory
    -b <name>, --initial-branch=<name>
        initial branch name
    --separate-git-dir=<git-dir>
        path to separate git directory
    --template=<template-dir>
        path to git directory templates
    <directory>
        directory to create repository in
